notes.title: My Virtual Friend is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After a great Steam Next Fest, I'm happy to say that the full version of My Virtual Friend is now out.

Those who played the demo will have already seen Seria, however, we have 3 new friends to accompany you:

 The gentle businessman Onizuka
 The steadfast rock Rokku
 And the lovely girl Aiko


All of these come with more voicelines, outfits, and customization, so you can make your own ideal friend. 

On top of that, we also added a whole bunch of QoL and bugfixes to give you as smooth of an experience as possible. 

If something does still go wrong, please let us know! The best way to do this is by making a post on the Steam discussion forums, or by joining our Discord server. 

We will be taking down the demo now that the full game is out, it doesn't really make much sense to have both versions available. The good news is that the full game is very fairly priced, and does feature more of everything as stated above. Thank you to everyone still who tried out our demo and provided us with feedback on how to make the game the best version possible.

We hope you enjoy the game as much as we did making it! If you did, please help us and other buyers out as well by leaving a review.

notes.title: Demo updates: QoL and final demo additions
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This will most likely be our final demo update before the game releases later this week, but we wanted to make sure some critical QoL issues were still addressed.

Additions⭐
- Headphone improvements: Before, your headphones only showed up when you were listening to music through a 3rd party application like Spotify. We've now added a toggle however if you want it to only show up when linked to your audio application, or just have it be permanently active.
- More outfits: Scarf, bucket hat, and propeller hat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469229/2cce16f7f2f580629c3b06b73fb366a8181f0a62.gif


Bugfixes🪲
- Reduced black border artifact: We had some visual artifacts that caused your friend to have a black border when running the game in transparent mode. Whilst not entirely gone, we've been able to drastically reduce this. Removing it entirely will be hard as we are now running into issues with Unity and the Windows API preventing further improvements.
- Improved visuals: We forgot to tick the anti-aliasing box, whoops
- Other transparency improvements: Certain black-colored materials (such as glasses) became transparent instead of black when running the game in transparent mode.

We hope you've enjoyed the demo until now, and I'd like to say thank you once again to everyone who left a review on the demo or posted in our Steam discussions, it helped us a lot in making the game even better. 

If you haven't done so yet, feel free to share any further thoughts and comments with us, so we can make the v1 launch even better!

notes.title: Demo Updates: Better friend customization
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We've been getting some more player feedback as part of the Steam Next Fest (keep it coming!), which has led to some even better features we've implemented.

This update is a pretty short one changelog wise, but I think the ability to customize your character has drastically improved the game, you can really make your friend yours now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469229/733bd18de38d31dd4e5a949ac05f132f95e8510b.gif

Additions⭐

 Character customization: You could already change your friend's outfits, but now you can change her as well. We currently support a base set of custom eye and hair colors, let us know if you feel like some are missing. 


Bugfixes🪲

 Made it so buttons can actually be clicked easily in the transparent window mode

notes.title: German and Russian localization
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Jumping with in a quick update 36 hours after the start of Steam Next Fest (did you wishlist yet?).

We noticed quite some wishlists coming from Russian and German players as well, so we added localizations for these languages to the game.

On top of that we have 2 more smaller additions:

 An extra hat, the Beret
 You can now give headpats to your friend

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469229/8a9b7d12247c614489e0bd1e81dc8654c2744161.gif

Hope you like these updates! As always, if you have any feedback, don't hesitate to let us know through the Steam discussions or by joining our Discord.

notes.title: Demo updates: Facial animations, outfits & more
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a bit over a week since our last update and we're back with some more great improvements. 

We've been expanding the core of our characters more, with better support for outfits and facial animations, so that it doesn't feel like a simple static 3D model, but instead someone who's really there with you.

We've also started work on implementing more characters (the plan is to have 5 for the v1 launch), and whilst there are definitely some hiccups, we're making some good progress as well in this regard.

As always, if you haven't done so yet, the best way to support us is to wishlist on Steam. We'd love to hear more about how you've been experiencing My Virtual Friend as well, so don't hesitate to leave a comment if you have any further thoughts/suggestions. 

Additions⭐

 Facial animations. Gone is the static look on your friend's face, she'll now respond more to what you're doing.
 More outfits and customization options, with different hats, glasses, and more, we're working towards adding more clothing options down the line. Expect even more to come in the coming updates.
 We also wanted to have it so your friend reacts to what you're doing, so we now have more integrations where she knows what you're doing. Watching YouTube/Netflix? She'll now grab a bucket of popcorn and enjoy the show. 
 Need to lock in and activate the grindset? We added a Pomodoro timer in the brand-new Activities panel.


Bugfixes🪲

 The song visualizer now supports non-Latin characters

notes.title: My Virtual Friend is now on Steam
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

I'm happy to announce that after My Virtual Friend has now hit Steam, along with a demo to accompany it. Expect regular updates for this demo as we add more features based on your feedback.

My Virtual Friend is still in development, with the demo serving as our approach of "Early Access".

The core idea for the game is already implemented howerver, with some extras:

 Cute girl(s) doing cute things
 Interact and customize your character
 8 different instrumental music playlists to help you focus 
 Media player integration (Spotify, Apple, Foobar,...)
 Translated (EN, JP, CN, KR)


Roadmap
I'm hoping to make this game together with your feedback. The game will remain completely free until the v1 release (which would add multiple characters). After this, a free demo version will still remain available as well. 

This roadmap is what I've planned so far, but I would love to hear about the features you would like to have as well, leave them in the comments below!

As Soon As Possible

 Option to move icon from Taskbar to Tray
 More outfits
 More ways to interact with your character
 More dynamic linking between what your character does and what you're doing


v1 Release

 Multiple characters
 More everything (voice lines, outfits, states, backgrounds, interactions,...)
 Photo mode


Maybe?

 Mac Support
 Custom Cursors
 Play your own local music files
 Import your own character (very unlikely anytime soon)


Help shape development
This isn't everything we've planned however, and we'd love to hear your thoughts as well. The best way for that is to try the demo out for yourself and leave a post in the community discussions. 

We hope you'll enjoy the game!
